items.name: Rocky Top 2023
items.information:
This competition is supported by CubingUSA.

The competitor limit has been reached. We are currently looking into options to expand the competitor limit. Please register (including payment) for the waiting list if you are interested. We will send any updates via email to those on the waiting list and registration list.

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
